# _libm_sse2_cos_precise), measured in a throwaway Windows clone on synthetic angles: the DFT's twiddle grid,
# j*(k*2*pi)/w and (j*k)*2*pi/w for w = n*p (n in 12..256, p in 1..5), harmonics k up to 10 (every k up to w/2

# every 60th of the others.
